sharedIdentityAndLayout:
Edit the supplied eight-direction sprite atlas into an actual ANIMATION POSE sheet, preserving the exact SAME adult East Asian man Jack in every frame: short tousled black hair, black rectangular glasses, blue work vest over rolled-sleeve ivory shirt, leather belts and forearm guards, dark trousers and brown boots, recognizable keyboard-shaped longsword in his ANATOMICAL RIGHT HAND. Detailed mature hand-painted/pre-rendered dark fantasy 2.5D ARPG art, realistic adult full-body proportions, existing identity/outfit/materials/soft overhead-left light, NOT chibi. Keep the same eight headings and same projected body scale as the reference.
Output ONE wide 4-column by 2-row atlas, eight complete figures, preferably2048x1024. Each 512-square logical cell has the same camera, 45-degree elevated isometric view looking down. EXACT order: TOP south/front facing down; southeast facing lower right; east/RIGHT full profile; northeast/back three-quarter facing upper right. BOTTOM north/full back; northwest/back three-quarter facing upper left; west/LEFT full profile; southwest/front three-quarter facing lower left. Rotate the SAME posed body into the eight orientations, do not reuse front views for diagonals, mirror anatomy, or swap weapon hands.
All figures entirely inside their own cell, generous empty margins for weapon/hair/boots, same global body scale. Body's ground contact baseline at 90% of each cell. Do not resize a figure to compensate for its pose. Transparent RGBA empty background, no ground, bases, cast shadow, drawn checkerboard, particles, motion blur, speed lines, glow, writing, text, labels, grid outlines or logos.
